description: Use this when the person asks whether the Evictions API team has written about a case, or before writing to it. Input: the case `id`. Returns the messages on a case, the person’s own and the team’s, oldest first, each with its author, text and time. Do not use this for the case’s events (use evictions_get_case_events). Next: evictions_send_case_message to reply. Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

name: evictions_list_case_messages
title: Case messages
